recipe.build:
chmod +x gradlew
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
echo "ndk.dir=${ANDROID_NDK}" >> local.properties
./gradlew assembleCommunityRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-size 16 --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/community/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
